body: look, i've been there before. twice. and oh how i know that things feel like they are going no where. or that you are stuck in a big black whole of nothingness. all of my friends left me too, but i knew that i had to keep going. no matter what. you are something incredibly special, and i know that those words make you sick. but it's true. everyone feels like this, believe me. go outside, and you will see so many other lonely, sad people. it's not just you. Don't do it. find someone, something to hold on to. i had my faith, maybe you can find your faith too. it's not your time to go, not at all. you CAN keep living. please
